free_tier_limits: Fully free; no paid plans. Rate limit 80 requests/second.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL CONFIRMED. Official docs (https://metmuseum.github.io/) state the Collection API is free/open with no paid tier and document a rate limit of 80 requests per second. Verifier B’s “incorrect” was a wording-only tweak (“is … per official docs”) that does not change the facts; keep the original concise free_tier_limits string. rate_limits field already covers the 80 rps figure.
